name: chrome-extension-builder
description: Plan, build, test, and improve Chrome Manifest V3 extensions with specialist skills, scoped project context, evidence reports, and an optional local Studio.

interface.longDescription: For developers building and improving Chrome Manifest V3 extensions. Guides research, architecture, interface design, frontend implementation, optional backend integration, testing, security reviews, and release preparation. Helps resume explicitly supplied project context, compare approaches, triage sanitized feedback, and produce evidence-linked reports. Optional local helpers scaffold, check, package, and track projects; Studio provides visual project reviews when local execution is available. Follow-up job plans can be activated through supported host schedulers only when requested. Browser verification, deployment, publication, and approval require separate evidence.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan and build a Chrome extension from my idea.
Design a popup and side panel for my Chrome extension.
Review my extension's permissions and prepare a release checklist.

review.commerce_description: No plugin purchases, subscription, checkout or upsell. Generated extension products are separate.

publication.release_notes: Version 2.3.0 adds scoped project context, decision provenance, feedback triage, session outcomes, evidence-linked JSON/Markdown reports and opt-in host follow-up job definitions. Studio adds seven review views, stale evidence and candidate diff review. Includes 23 skills and 12 specialist roles. No MCP, telemetry, credential intake or automatic scheduling.
